EVPN(ELAN)-VPLS: MAC Move and Sticky MAC Handling

si_mode.label: Seamless Integration (current PE-1 HA_TEST_ELAN)
si_mode.description: EVPN instance has seamless-integration enabled. VPLS PW control plane is active but data plane is BNI (Best but Not Installed). PW MAC learning CANNOT happen on THIS instance.
si_mode.note: PW tests now unblocked via spirent_vpls_cp mode using a SEPARATE non-SI instance

spirent_vpls_cp.label: Spirent VPLS BGP Peer on SI-enabled instance (PW active via MPLS)
spirent_vpls_cp.description: EVPN instance PW_TEST_ELAN WITH seamless-integration enabled. VPLS RTs (export-l2vpn-vpls, import-l2vpn-vpls) are configured under the SI > protocols > bgp subtree -- this is the ONLY valid location in DNOS. Spirent establishes l2vpn-vpls BGP peering via full ISIS+LDP+BGP chain. PW is 'Installed' (not BNI) because only the Spirent peers via l2vpn-vpls for this EVI (no competing EVPN RT-2 routes). Spirent sends MPLS-labeled L2 frames via vpls-stream. PE-1 pops MPLS label, learns source MAC from inner L2 frame. DNAAS BD carries MPLS frames transparently (ethertype 0x8847 forwarded like any L2 frame).
spirent_vpls_cp.setup: Auto-provisioned via spirent_vpls_provisioner.py. Full chain: label-pool -> BGP l2vpn-vpls AF -> EVPN instance + SI + VPLS RT (under SI subtree) -> AC sub-interface -> BGP neighbor -> Spirent ISIS + LDP + BGP l2vpn-vpls. See ~/.cursor/spirent-reference/vpls-pw-establishment.md for complete reference.
spirent_vpls_cp.si_requirement: MANDATORY. VPLS RTs (export-l2vpn-vpls, import-l2vpn-vpls) are ONLY valid under seamless-integration > protocols > bgp. Removing SI also removes all VPLS RT config and the PW disappears. See learned rule dnos-vpls-rt-must-be-under-seamless-integration.
spirent_vpls_cp.convergence_chain: ISIS L2 adj (30-45s) -> route to loopback (+5s) -> LDP OPERATIONAL (+10s) -> BGP ESTABLISHED (+10s) -> PW Installed (+5s)

tooling.spirent_tool.py isis-peer --area-id 49.0: ISIS adjacency (area converted to STC hex 490001 internally)

spirent_vpls_cp_dual.label: Two Spirent VPLS Peers (PW <-> PW data plane)
spirent_vpls_cp_dual.description: Same SI instance as spirent_vpls_cp, but TWO Spirent VPLS BGP peers (different VE-IDs and source IPs on the same Spirent port) so that the DUT sees two distinct PWs. Required for PW-to-PW MAC moves: same inner-src-mac sent on PW1 ingress label first, then PW2 ingress label = PW-to-PW move event. Single ISIS+LDP+BGP chain is shared (STC devices on same port share ISIS instance); only the BGP VPLS sessions and their associated PWs are duplicated.
spirent_vpls_cp_dual.setup: Auto-provisioned via spirent_vpls_provisioner.provision_spirent_vpls_cp_dual(). Builds the single SI EVPN instance + label pool + BGP l2vpn-vpls AF, then creates two STC EmulatedDevice objects with VE-IDs 1 and 3 (or as configured), each with its own VPLS BGP route block and its own MPLS PW.
spirent_vpls_cp_dual.convergence_chain: Same as spirent_vpls_cp + ~10-20s extra for the second BGP VPLS session and PW.

tooling.mac_trigger.py execute_mac_move_pw_to_pw: Sends inner MAC on PW1 label, then PW2 label, on the same Spirent port

dual_pe_mode.label: Dual-PE topology (MH + real PW traffic)
dual_pe_mode.description: Two PEs with VPLS peering. Spirent sends L2 traffic to PE-2 AC, PE-2 forwards over PW to PE-1. Real PW MAC learning.
dual_pe_mode.setup: Requires second PE (PE-4 or similar) with VPLS PW to PE-1

dual_pe_shared_rt_inner_vlan_divergence.label: Dual-PE shared-RT topology with per-PE inner-VLAN divergence
dual_pe_shared_rt_inner_vlan_divergence.description: PE-1 + RR-SA-2 share EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 via shared VPLS RT 1234567:2001. PE-1's AC stays at outer 214 / inner 4001; RR-SA-2's AC was moved to outer 214 / inner 2001 (committed 2026-05-01 via dnos_multi_device_commit). DNAAS fabric BD g_yor_v214 is single_tag on outer 214 and preserves inner end-to-end at every leaf+spine+super-spine hop. Q-in-Q AC classification at each PE selects exactly ONE PE per Spirent inner-VLAN choice -- PE-1 AC matches outer 214 / inner 4001 only; RR-SA-2 AC matches outer 214 / inner 2001 only. PE-1 has both EVPN RT-2 export AND VPLS PW; RR-SA-2 has VPLS PW only (no EVPN RT-2 export for this EVI), so a MAC learned on RR-SA-2's AC reaches PE-1 strictly via the VPLS PW (peer 2.2.2.2, ingress label 1032295). VPLS PW key is (EVI, site-id) and survived the AC swap.
dual_pe_shared_rt_inner_vlan_divergence.setup: RR-SA-2 must have bundle-100.2001 (outer 214 / inner 2001) bound to EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 as both interface AND seamless-integration site-interface. The full atomic commit is encoded in tests/basic_learning/recipe.json under topology.* and was applied permanently on 2026-05-01.
dual_pe_shared_rt_inner_vlan_divergence.isolation_proof: dnos_dnaas_path vlan=214 confirms every fabric hop is single_tag/preserve. dnos_dnaas_inverse_path on PE-1 ge400-0/0/5.4001 returns inner_vlan=4001; on RR-SA-2 bundle-100.2001 returns inner_vlan=2001. A Spirent stream's inner-VLAN choice is the deterministic per-PE selector.
dual_pe_shared_rt_inner_vlan_divergence.tests_unblocked_vs_v1: basic_learning SC03 PW source is now a REAL remote PE (RR-SA-2) instead of Spirent acting as a fake VPLS peer. No admin shut/unshut required to isolate PE-1 during PW learning.

tooling.dnos_dnaas_inverse_path device_name=<pe>: outer/inner VLAN per AC, full chain back to Spirent port

cannot_do.capability: PW via SI instance WITHOUT dedicated VPLS-only EVI
cannot_do.reason: SI mode with competing EVPN RT-2 routes sets PW to BNI. PW_TEST_ELAN uses SI + VPLS RTs but NO competing EVPN neighbors for this EVI, so PW is 'Installed'. If EVPN RT-2 routes appear for the same EVI, PW becomes 'Uninstalled' (BNI).

tests.infra_detail: v2 (2026-05-01) -- PE-1 + RR-SA-2 share EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 via shared VPLS RT 1234567:2001 with per-PE inner-VLAN divergence (PE-1 inner 4001, RR-SA-2 inner 2001 on shared outer 214). Single test_mac 00:de:ad:be:ef:01 across SC01->SC02->SC03 exercises basic mobility within basic_learning: SC01 Local AC on PE-1 -> SC02 Spirent BGP RT-2 inject (mobility +1, PE-1 re-advertises to RR-SA-2 -> PE-4) -> SC03 Spirent -> RR-SA-2 AC (PW source on PE-1 from REAL remote PE 2.2.2.2, mobility +1, RR-SA-2 doesn't export RT-2 so PE-1 stays withdrawn) -> SC04 stop+clear+verify zero. Verifier helpers fixed in this revision: verify_mac_flags + verify_forwarding_state now accept absent_is_pass (was TypeError); new verify_mac_per_view + verify_evi_moved_events_increment for positive/negative bug-catching assertions per scenario. RR-SA-2 AC committed 2026-05-01 via dnos_multi_device_commit: bundle-100.4001 -> bundle-100.2001.

Real-topology AC<->PW single move derived from passed TEST_mac_mob_basic_SW205160. Uses the PE-4 untagged local AC and RR-SA-2 real PW source; move scenarios preserve prior MAC source state instead of clearing before trigger.
SC01-SC02: si_mode; SC03-SC04,SC06: spirent_vpls_cp (PW via Spirent VPLS); SC05: si_mode
Pure config-validation. Reuses any existing SI EVPN instance + a non-SI instance. No traffic. Always rolls back, never commits.
Remote-to-remote RT-2 sequence race via single Spirent BGP peer with differentiated next-hop values. Wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 spirent_evpn_seq_race handler (recipe_type: move_matrix).

Bulk RT-2 injection at 64K scale via spirent_inject_evpn_mac_route --count parameter. Wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 spirent_bulk_learn_assert handler (recipe_type: bulk_learn, skip_cross_layer_check=True).

Cross-domain suppression sanctions (blackhole / shutdown / suppress). Wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 cross_domain_sanction_assert handler (recipe_type: pw_suppression). Handler commits the sanction via persistent SSH then drives Spirent RT-2 flap. DNOS 26.2 validated: blackhole/shutdown/suppress (NOT drop/freeze).

Clear commands (mac-suppression / mac-history / restore-cycles) as active triggers. Wired 2026-04-21 via Block 3 clear_assert_state handler (recipe_type: clear_matrix). Handler runs clear command + optional before/after show captures. PASSES if clear CLI returns clean output.

experimental_policy.description: Recipes under 'experimental_tests' are gap-analysis drafts authored alongside the suite redesign but not yet wired to the orchestrator's ACTION_TRIGGER_MAP. The linter relaxes trigger.action validation for these recipes (warnings only, not errors). They MUST stay schema-clean (valid JSON, jira_key present, infra mode known) so they remain promotable to the main 'tests' array as soon as their listed blockers are resolved.
experimental_policy.promotion_rule: When all blockers for an experimental test are resolved, move its entry from 'experimental_tests' to 'tests', remove the 'status' / 'status_note' fields from the recipe, and re-run the linter.
experimental_policy.2026_04_21_batch_promotion: G1/G3/G4/G5 promoted from experimental_tests to tests[] after Block 1/2/3 strategic refactor: (1) shared/recipe_profiles.py declarative profiles replace per-type if/else branches, (2) four generic handlers (spirent_evpn_seq_race, spirent_bulk_learn_assert, cross_domain_sanction_assert, clear_assert_state) wire recipe trigger verbs to orchestrator execution, (3) runtime_corrections.json captures DNOS 26.2 live-validated syntax (blackhole != drop, suppress != freeze, ordering rules) that every recipe and handler now references. experimental_tests is empty until new gap-analysis work lands.
